???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is the number of a byte in memory called, and which byte gives a value its one?"

        An address. A value's address is the number of its first byte.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 8. Data in memory](../compiler/guide/stage-8-data-in-memory.md).

    ??? question "What is the large, numbered storage area a running program reads and writes called?"

        Memory, one very long row of bytes, each with its own number.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 8. Data in memory](../compiler/guide/stage-8-data-in-memory.md).

    ??? question "What is the 8-bit unit that files and memory are stored in called?"

        A byte. It holds one of 256 values, and one character may need several bytes.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 1. Source text and error messages](../compiler/guide/stage-1-source-and-diagnostics.md).
